page.overview:
Who is James Komack?

Admiral James Komack was a male Starfleet flag officer who lived during the mid-23rd century. In 2267, he was the head of Starfleet Command in Sector 9.

That same year, Komack was responsible for overseeing the 's mission to Omicron Ceti III. After he learned of the survival of the colonists, he ordered them evacuated to Starbase 27. ()

Later that year, Admiral Komack denied the request of the Enterprise to divert to but to maintain course for Altair VI. Komack later allowed Enterprise to divert following a request made by Vulcan matriarch T'Pau. ()

Admiral Komack, who was first mentioned as a dialogue reference in "This Side of Paradise", later appeared in "Amok Time", played by Byron Morrow, who later appeared as Admiral Westervliet in .
